latHint: Think a happy face - not a roof timber.
pivHint: A BEAM of timber holds up the chalet roof - but to BEAM at someone means to do what?
winText: Ear to ear. BEAM was the pivot - roof timber to a broad SMILE.
lossText: SMILE - a happy curve of the mouth. BEAM was the pivot: a roof BEAM to BEAMing with a SMILE.
